makes the following rules:

Citation and commencement
1. (1)  These rules may be cited as the Syariah Court Civil Procedure (Fees)
(Federal Territories) Rules 2011.

(2)  These Rules come into operation on the date of its publication in the
Gazette.

therein.

(2)  Subrule (1) is not app licable for cases conducted by t he Legal Aid
Department or its panels of solicitors.
